config_dir.description: Directory where eth-tools configuration files are stored.

snmp_version.description: SNMP protocol version. Supported values: SNMP_VERSION_2c, SNMP_VERSION_3.

snmp_community_string.description: Community string used for SNMPv2c authentication.

snmp_security_level.description: Security level for SNMPv3. Supported: NOAUTH, AUTHNOPRIV, AUTHPRIV.

snmp_authentication_protocol.description: Authentication protocol for SNMPv3. Supported: MD5, SHA.

snmp_encryption_protocol.description: Encryption protocol for SNMPv3. Supported: AES, DES.

plane_enable.description: Enable flag for the default plane. 1=enabled, 0=disabled.

plane_hosts_file.description: Filename containing hosts for the default plane.

plane_switches_file.description: Filename containing switches for the default plane.

plane2_name.description: Name of the secondary plane example.

plane2_enable.description: Enable flag for the secondary plane. 1=enabled, 0=disabled.

plane2_hosts_file.description: Filename containing hosts for the secondary plane.

plane2_switches_file.description: Filename containing switches for the secondary plane.

plane2_snmp_port.description: SNMP port override for the secondary plane.
